correctness.rationale: For independent R_i with CDF F_i, 1-prod F_i = P(union_i {R_i>r_i}) by de Morgan, whereas simultaneous strict upper survival P(intersection_i {R_i>r_i})=prod_i(1-F_i). Inclusive lattice survival replaces r_i by r_i-1. For two identical tails s the first is 2s-s^2 and second is s^2, so their ratio 2/s-1 diverges as s->0; for n the ratio~n s^(1-n). Componentwise rectangular truncation preserves independence. The source Eq 3.6 p_joint/(1-Fjoint) measures a different union-conditioned construction, not the Prop.1 joint-cell hazard with a product of inclusive marginal survivals. IMPORTANT precision: the authors explicitly acknowledge directly after Eq.3.6 that the latter is a different multivariate hazard construction, so the defect is misleading co-exceedance interpretation rather than an unacknowledged algebraic identity in that paragraph.
